# Age

This chapter focuses time trends in age


**Input**

-   DemographyGunOwners/data/clean/gs-gun-owners.rds

**Output**

-   DemographyGunOwners/output

**Last ran**

-   `r format(Sys.Date(), format = "%A, %B %d, %Y")`
```{r,  message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
packages <-
  c(
    "tidyverse",
    "purrr",
    "haven",
    "survey",
    "tidyr",
    "gtsummary",
    "janitor",
```

## Import data

```{r}
gun <-
  read_rds(
     here(
      path_od, 
      "data",
      "clean",
      "gs-gun-owners.rds"
      )
  )
```


## Estimates with CIs

```{r}
gun %>% tabyl(age4)
```

```{r}
des <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,          # no clustering info
  weights = ~weight,
  data = gun
)

age <- 
  svyby(
    ~age4,
    ~year,
    des,
    svymean,
    vartype = c("se", "ci"),
    level = 0.95
    ) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(across(-year, ~ .x * 100))


long <-
  age %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -year,
    names_to = "name",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stat = case_when(
      str_starts(name, "se_")   ~ "se",
      str_starts(name, "ci_l_") ~ "ci_l",
      str_starts(name, "ci_u_") ~ "ci_u",
      TRUE                      ~ "pct"
    ),
    group = name %>%
      str_remove("^se_") %>%
      str_remove("^ci_l_") %>%
      str_remove("^ci_u_")
  ) %>%
  select(year, group, stat, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  ) %>% 
   mutate(
    age = 
      case_when(
        str_detect(group, "18_29") ~ 1,
        str_detect(group, "30_44") ~ 2,
        str_detect(group, "45_59") ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ 4) %>% 
      factor(
        levels = 1:4, 
        labels = 
          c("18-29", "30-44", "45-59", "60+")
      ),
    # lower CI at least 0
    ci_l = ifelse(ci_l < 0, 0, ci_l)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(pct)) 
```


## Gun ownership by age overtime


```{r}
cap <-
  paste0(
    "This figure plots percent of U.S. gun-owner adults (N=",
     nrow(gun),") stratified by age group from seven waves of the National ",
    "Survey of Gun Policy, spanning 2013 to 2025."
  )
```

```{r}
long %>% 
  mutate(year = factor(year)) %>%  
  ggplot(
    aes(x = year, y = pct, group = age, color = age)
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.25) +
  theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.15, .8),
     legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = .5)
  ) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("nationalparkcolors::DeathValley") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 60, 10),
    limits = c(0, 60)
    ) +
  labs(
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Percent of U.S. gun owners",
    color = "Age (years)"
  ) 

ggsave(
  height = 6,
  width = 8, 
  here(
    path_ol, 
    "figures/age.jpeg"
  )
)
```



```{r}
long %>% 
  mutate(year = factor(year)) %>% 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = year, y = pct, group = age, color = age, fill = age)
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = .5)
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Althoff") +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Althoff") +
  labs(
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Percent of U.S. gun owners",
    fill = "Age (years)"
  ) 

ggsave(
  height = 6,
  width = 8, 
  here(
    path_ol, 
    "figures/age.jpeg"
  )
)
```
